name: egenome-tests
description: The eGenome.ai app tests: read runs, failures and their causes, one test in full, unit tests, codes, connected phone; run the unit tests; start device suites after a confirmation.
long_description: Starts the MCP server in the eGenome.ai test project (mcp/server.mjs) from the folder you choose. It reads the same data as the test dashboard (reports/) and never returns .env values. It can also run the unit tests, and start smoke / regression / layout on the emulator: those clear the app's data, so the assistant must first show what will happen and only start after you agree; one run at a time, with time limits. Run `npm run mcp:install` in the project once before installing.
